title: React apps get login and account tools
summary:
React apps gained login hooks and ready-made account UI, while Pollen accounting and community records got a tidy-up.

The team added `@pollinations_ai/sdk/react` with a `PolliProvider` and hooks for login state, account details, balance, key details, and usage. Apps can set OAuth key permissions, model restrictions, Pollen budgets, and expiry defaults, then override them per login. A new `@pollinations_ai/ui` package adds themed, auth-aware components, with a React showcase for trying them and generating example code.

The team centralized ledger rounding at eight decimal places. BYOP debits, developer credits, and generation tracking now use the same charged amount, so recorded totals match the ledger.

An agent refreshed app metrics and health-check records without changing app functionality. The team also clarified the quick contribution flow and removed an outdated Contributor badge promise.

daily.title: React login and account hooks
daily.text: Add Pollinations login to a React app with `PolliProvider`, then read account, balance, key, and usage details through hooks. Set model restrictions, Pollen budgets, permissions, and expiry for OAuth login. [Explore the React SDK](https://react.pollinations.ai).

daily.title: Ready-made React account UI
daily.text: Use themed login, identity, balance, and key-detail components from `@pollinations_ai/ui`, or try them in the React showcase and generate example code. [Explore the React UI](https://react.pollinations.ai).
